text: Grouped the Screen menu into nine flows and cut it to the 34 screens clicking can't reach quickly. Added a test build for sessions with new users, with no review strip or New badges, opening on Product Overview with the alert already investigated, and a moderator task sheet.
Graph view now shows only on notebooks with cells, the convert to dashboard filters suggestion shows on every dashboard that still repeats variables, and Adjust the alert applies the change with Undo

Made the shell work at phone width the way the shipped MobileNav does, with the sidebar in a left sheet and the agent sidebar as an overlay. Added a seeded No change found investigation with its checks and Adjust the alert…, next-step chips under Ask and agent sidebar answers that write the request into the composer, Update CRM fields… with 8 HubSpot updates, the approval card, the read back and the Deny path, and an illustration of the finished answer posted back in the Slack thread. The new surfaces are marked New

Added Make an app in Design (8.3a to 8.3d) and dashboard filters as first-class objects, all marked New. The dashboard and notebook ⋯ menus open a dialog to name the outputs an app can read; the agent asks Design to build it, the draft opens in an illustrative Design frame with live data, Data from Analytics and Publish (Builder account first, then Publishing started and Published), and the source dashboard shows the app reading it. Dashboard filters now pick a type and a field by meaning, compile to SQL in one place, show which panels they apply to and why others can't be filtered, carry defaults that views override, show as chips with Compiled SQL in a panel's editor, and a legacy dashboard converts its {{timeRangeStart}} and {{plan}} variables through the agent as one change with Undo

Added notebook depth from 8.4, all marked New: a drill menu on chart bars that adds a linked cell, Top N and calculated columns with formula typeahead, Filter, Pivot and Map cells built from pickers, a reactive cell graph with a floating Graph view, inline review of agent edits with Keep, Undo and a saved version per thread, SQL typeahead with a schema browser and cell reference chips, scheduled runs, and a small composer on a published app that answers from its cells only
The bell's unread count is blue, and investigations sit below Personal and Shared in Notebooks

Added automatic investigations (Phase 8, bet A), all marked New. The Activation funnel conversion alert gained Investigate when it fires; when it fires, a toast, the new notifications bell and the alert's conversion line show Investigating… with live progress, and the run plays back in the agent sidebar as a plan of 7 checks within 5 minutes and $0.50, each with what it read and what it found. The result is an evidence notebook, Why Connected a data source to Built a dashboard conversion fell, with a plain-language answer and a confidence label, five findings with their evidence (a segment breakdown, the matching release, the error spike, five replay cards that open Sessions, and affected accounts with MRR), What I could not check, and Next steps that hand off to the agent and come back as drafts that need confirmation. Notebooks lists Investigations with their status, and Why did this change?… in a metric or chart panel's menu starts the same investigation for that panel

Compacted the Share popover on both tabs to the density of the rest of the app, the toolkit change the owner made for every app: 320px wide, 24px tabs, invite field, role selects, Add and remove buttons with 12px text, 28px people, general access and agent destination rows with 20px avatars and 14px logos, and 8px between sections, all on the 4/8 grid. Removed the Share link row from People, since the split button's link segment copies the link. The People tab went from 257px to 172px tall

Replaced the header "+" with an Add button in the secondary fill, immediately left of Share at the same compact size, whose menu reads Chart…, SQL query… and Section and adds to the end of the dashboard. Added an insert bar on hover or focus between dashboard rows, and above the first and below the last, that opens the same menu and inserts at that gap; it hides while a panel drags. Shrank the Share split to the compact header size (32px, 12px text, 14px link icon) and dropped the user-plus icon; both segments keep the solid primary fill with a hairline between them, since Share is the page's primary action

Moved Views out of the header into the filter bar as its first control, a View picker naming the active view (Default when none). Its menu lists the saved views with the default marked, then Save as new view…, Set as default and Delete view…. Changing a filter on a saved view reads "· Edited" with Save and Reset in the bar; with no view, Save view… and Clear all stay. The bar's separate Save as View dialog is gone, so there is one save path, and the sidebar's views still select the view in the bar

Made Share the dashboard header's primary action: the Share and copy link split button Clips uses, opening People and Agents tabs, where Agents copies an agent prompt or opens the dashboard in Claude, Claude Code or Codex. Replaced Add panel with a "+" menu (Describe a panel…, Write SQL…, Add section), regrouped the ⋯ menu as text-only items, and moved Created and Updated into Dashboard history. Undo and Redo left the menu for the Saved toast and ⌘Z, and visibility and the hidden state left it for Share and the banner; the owner can reverse any of the three
Regrouped the notebook's ⋯ menu the same way: text-only Publish as app…, Notebook history…, Archive and Delete permanently…

Moved New chat, New dashboard and New notebook into a "+" in each sidebar section header, removed the New rows and the second chevron under Ask, and left one "Show N more" row that expands in place, so the header chevron is the only collapse control
Added the alpha badge beside Analytics in the sidebar brand, expanded and collapsed, with the active development popover it opens

Moved Publish as app from the notebook header into the notebook's actions menu as Publish as app (Publish settings once published, with Open app and Unpublish), renamed Analysis history to Notebook history, and drew Re-run and Open notebook at the dashboard header's compact size
Moved notebooks out of Dashboards into their own Notebooks section in the sidebar, with a Notebooks list page, New notebook, and an All notebooks back link
Drew every funnel step bar in the same series color, keeping the amber drop-off
Moved the funnel alert bell onto the conversion line between two steps, so the alert watches that conversion rate with a 7-day preview
Changed Add as filter to open the agent with the request written, and the agent then adds the filter, rewrites the panel SQL, and shows its changes with Undo
Replaced the Decimal format with a Decimal places setting on Number, Currency, and Percent in the column menu and the chart's Y axis menu
Started the Analytics operators prototype with click to edit tables and charts, notebooks, funnels, retention, and alerts
